text:
maya: Quick UX check: when pinning in compact catalog the filter row wraps and perf badges overlap. Loom: https://loom.example/pin-compact

sam: yikes. We should avoid layout shift. Option: reserve toolbar height + collapse less-important pills into a +N overflow.

rui: accessibility: overflow must be keyboard-focusable and announce count. aria-label example: "Show 3 hidden filters"

alex: badge visual weight is high. Proposal: outline icons + muted text, only color for regressions.

jordan: also show full badge details on hover/focus via tooltip; ensure tooltips keyboard reachable.

anna: copy: "Lock version" vs "Pin version"? suggest "Lock to version" to signal immutability.

design-bot: uploaded frame "compact-compare/overflow-and-pin" to Figma.

maya: plan: 1) implement single-line pill +N overflow (dev). 2) move pin to sticky right slot with version + policy menu (design). 3) de-emphasize badges + tooltips (design+dev). 4) aria updates (rui). Sam will estimate.

sam: estimate 2 dev days for CSS + keyboard nav tests.

jordan: I'll prototype copy and hover states.

rui: will add aria snippets to accessibility checklist and test with VoiceOver.

maya: thanks — small follow-up: ensure +N excludes pinned chips and counts only hidden filters.
